subject: Saved DND-aware Size, Remaining, Done and completion facts for classic My Torrents

scope.allowed_observations: Read original committed Java source and native baseline bytes; static text/brace/hash inspection only.
excluded: Ordinary Java constructors/configuration/listeners/managers, recovery/facade initialization and profile writes
A copied or extracted formula probe being described as actual original Java runtime equality
Native production, tests, CMake and shared plan changes
scope.open_scope: DND-aware manager metrics, per-file downloaded facts and pane compatibility remain work to implement and qualify; this audit does not defer or reduce that scope.

context_evidence.relation: Earlier broad audit; this additive review derives the exact DND formulas and saved-only boundary.
Earlier proposal; no existing file is rewritten.

inventory.completedbytes: DownloadManagerStatsImpl saved completed bytes C, including skipped-file downloaded bytes. GlobalManagerImpl restores Long when present and saves getDownloadCompletedBytes().
inventory.downloaded: Lifetime received traffic; never substitute for C or selected downloaded bytes.
inventory.state: Startup state is not a DND completion boolean.
inventory.absence: C starts at -1, but manager construction may first seed it to full size from resume completion/for-seeding. Missing completedbytes cannot be inferred to be zero or -1 as a final startup outcome using only the inventory.

cache.location: active/cache.dat gzip state list; matching binary torrent hash, last encountered original map entry wins.
cache.attributes: CachedStateWrapper.export stores the entire torrent attributes map, not just displayname. Constructor retains that map; getAdditionalMapProperty(attributes) returns it without delegate fixup when present.
cache.size: CachedStateWrapper.getSize() returns cached size only if >0; otherwise attempts delegate fixup, returning its size if successful or 0 if fixup fails. A saved cache zero/negative/missing size alone is not proof of an original no-fixup zero-sized torrent.
cache.coherence: Inventory and cache are separate saved files. A copied snapshot can own consistent inputs, but source cache fields do not prove current payload verification, freshness or a live atomic observation.

attributes.name: K, saved skipped-file-set length
attributes.meaning: Sum of length for skipped files when last calculated; any negative saved value requests original recomputation, not a no-skipped-files sentinel.

attributes.name: B, saved skipped-but-downloaded bytes
attributes.meaning: Sum of downloaded bytes for skipped files when last calculated. Absence has source default zero; this is a defaulted cache fact, not verified zero downloaded bytes.

attributes.name: F, cached controller facts
attributes.type: Long on decoded bencode; getter also accepts Boolean/Integer in in-memory maps
attributes.meaning: Bit0 HASDND=1, bit1 COMPLETE_NO_DND=2. Parameter presence is distinct from getter default zero.

attributes.name: metadata-download flags
attributes.meaning: getFlag tests (flags & mask)!=0 over the full signed long; not low32 narrowing.

attributes.name: Per-file downloaded byte list
attributes.meaning: Used by file skeleton restoration. Not an aggregate selected-completion substitute without exact geometry/index and skip policy.

invalid_types: attributes, parameters or filedownloaded of non-map type reach original Map casts; source points can throw ClassCastException. Do not describe them as ordinary empty maps.
getLongAttribute casts the stored value to Long before defaults. Bytes/list/map at skipfss, skipbdl or flags can throw ClassCastException. It does not parse numeric text or use low32.

getLongParameter accepts Boolean, Integer and Long; missing/null uses the declared default, other types log Invalid parameter and return0. For a present malformed dndflags value, parameterExists remains true and the controller treats the returned0 as cached facts. A bounded native malformed-field/unknown policy must be described as policy, not identical exception behavior.

The relevant long-attribute getters do not range-check Long values. Negative B, K greater than T, C greater than T and inconsistent cached flags are not sanitized into a coherent tuple by these methods.
getLongAttribute/getMapAttribute call informWillRead and use a monitor; these are not safe functions to invoke from a read-only native snapshot adapter.
parameter_details: State construction uses an empty parameter map only when the map is absent/null. parameterExists is containsKey, not getLongParameter()!=0.
setLongParameter always stores a Long, including explicit zero; no default-value elision. setParameterDefault removes the entry.
getDefaultOverride contains no DND_FLAGS override. The declared default0 therefore does not encode missing cached-values initialization.
Unknown F high bits and a negative signed F are accepted; the controller tests only masks1 and2. Do not int32-narrow before masking.
cache.dp records discard-pieces/resume-complete optimization; it is not C, downloaded bytes, or general pane-completion evidence.

notation.C: nonnegative saved completed bytes after any required original recalculation; includes skipped data
notation.K: saved skipped-file-set size after any required original recalculation
notation.wrap64: Java signed long two-complement arithmetic: each long addition/subtraction/multiplication wraps modulo2^64 then reinterprets signed; no C++ signed-overflow UB
notation.f32: Java float conversion/operation; keep float32 division and multiplication rather than replacing with double percent
notation.jfloatToInt: Java floating-to-int narrowing truncates towardzero, saturates outside int range, NaN→0; it is not low32 narrowing
notation.jlongToInt: Java long-to-int narrowing keeps low32bits; distinct from float-to-int

precedence: getDiskManagerIfNotTransient rejects INITIALIZING, ALLOCATING and CHECKING; otherwise a nonnull disk manager supplies full remaining directly.
Without eligible disk manager, getDownloadCompletedBytes always calls recalcDownloadCompleteBytes. If saved C<0, original sums every file.getDownloaded() with wrap64 and writes the saved in-memory C.
R has no clamp. C>T can yield negative R; the DND remaining wrapper performs its own later clamp.
If disk manager exists and state is neither INITIALIZING nor ALLOCATING, return diskManager.getSizeExcludingDND(). CHECKING, READY, FAULTY and other nonexcluded states all pass this particular gate.
Otherwise use T and getSkippedFileSetSize(). If K<0, original iterates the file facades, sums skipped lengths and downloaded counts, then setSkippedFileStats writes skipfss/skipbdl when changed.
The returned S is not clamped or range-validated. Native can compute S from T,K independently of C/B, provided its accepted-input policy is explicit.
Same direct selected-disk gate as selected size (excludes only INITIALIZING/ALLOCATING, not CHECKING).
Fallback reads full R first, then getSkippedFileSetSize(); if that latter call recalculates, it can change both K and B before subtraction.
Only Q<0 is clamped; there is no clamp to S, T or R. Do not collapse this to clamped(C-B)/S before preserving these ordered effects and intermediate wrap.

consequences: S==0 and S<0 short-circuit before any call to selected remaining. Missing C therefore need not prevent a source-derived S==0 Done value if S is independently established.
No upper clamp to1000 exists. Preserve the exact source or label any extra publication validation as native policy.
1000 with Q>0 is corrected to999 to avoid reporting100% due float rounding. A double calculation or integer-ratio calculation can change results.
Done1000 is not a universal pane-completion predicate. Cached flag completion, controller state and public assumedComplete are separate facts.

formula: When marked changed and current files exist, sum skipped file lengths→K and downloaded→B under file_piece_lock with Java long wrapping.
Its own percent method returns0 for S<=0, otherwise jfloatToInt(f32(1000)*f32(f32(wrap64(S-Q))/f32(S))). It lacks the Stats wrapper zero-size1000, negative clamp and1000→999 corrections.
effects: Updates cached disk fields and publishes changed K/B back through DownloadManagerStatsImpl.setSkippedFileStats.

setPieceDone maintains full remaining and per-file downloaded, clamps the per-file updated count into[0,length], adjusts B for skipped deltas and recalculates Q in finally. These live piece/file values are unavailable in a saved-only cache reader.
Separate getter calls can observe state changes. A native owned snapshot is an explicit observation boundary, not proof of original live atomicity.
live_disk_selected.critical_distinction: DoneItem calls manager.stats.getPercentDoneExcludingDND, not diskManager.getPercentDoneExcludingDND; do not substitute the latter.

rules: getCompleted can mean initialization/allocation/checking progress, returning stored completed or dm.getPercentDone in transient states.

getDownloadCompleted(bLive) measures full bytes, not selected bytes: (int)(wrap64(1000 * completedBytes) / total), total0→0. Its long-division and low32 int narrowing differ from selected float calculation.
Live nontransient full completion may update saved C; transient full completion returns a live value without updating saved C. These side effects are not a saved-cache arithmetic function.

controller_cache_initialization.rule: Only if parameterExists(dndflags): cachedComplete=(F&2)!=0; cachedHasDnd=(F&1)!=0; cachedValuesSet=true. Missing F leaves cachedValuesSet false; do not infer noDND from the getter default0.

rule: For each file in order: if skipped, set hasDnd=true; else if downloaded!=length, set selectedComplete=false. Stop once hasDnd && !selectedComplete.
Publish those three cache fields and write F=(selectedComplete?2:0)|(hasDnd?1:0).
edges: All-skipped and empty file arrays leave selectedComplete=true.
No totals, percent threshold or cache skip-byte comparison is consulted by this method.
This method writes state; it is not a permissible pure saved-reader fallback.

ordered_rules: If cachedValuesSet is false, try to fill file facades (which may create skeletons, consult live file set, calculate completeness and dispatch deferred priority notifications).
If cachedHasDnd is false, return stats.getRemaining()==0, regardless of includeDnd or cachedComplete bit.
With DND and disk manager state exactly READY, return (includeDnd ? dm.getRemaining() : dm.getRemainingExcludingDND()) == 0.
With DND and no READY disk manager: includeDnd=true→false; includeDnd=false→cachedComplete.
controller_isDownloadComplete.caveat: This table describes initialized controller cached-fact logic with no READY disk, not the public manager assumed-complete lifecycle.

public_manager.rule: isDownloadComplete(false) returns retained assumedComplete directly. true delegates controller(true). requestAssumedCompleteMode computes controller(false), invokes setAssumedComplete, then returns that candidate.
effects: Manager construction can initialize assumed completion from resume-data complete or for-seeding and set C=T.

GlobalManagerImpl restores optional completedbytes, restores stats K/B and then calls requestAssumedCompleteMode. Full startup can therefore reconcile the candidate, but also runs other initialization and observer effects.

setAssumedComplete can write completion timestamps, enqueue or run actual filesystem length/lastModified checks, change downloading state and notify completion listeners. Do not call it in a read-only projection or describe a cached candidate as its full lifecycle equality.

ordered_rule: Tag filter first; generic Download data-source type can accept either completion category.
For completion-specific classic panes, bCompleted = dm.isDownloadComplete(bDNDalwaysIncomplete). Select completed-only iff true, incomplete-only iff false.
Default false reaches retained assumedComplete; preference true reaches controller(true).
must_not_infer: Full C>=T is not the exact original predicate (controller noDND uses R==0, not R<=0).
Done==1000 or selectedRemaining==0 is not a substitute for cached controller facts or retained assumed state.
F==3 with incomplete full torrent can have selected Done100% and default completed pane while includeDnd=true remains false absent READY disk.
Unknown completion may be routed by a documented native fallback, but must not be re-labelled known original incomplete.

SizeItem.manager: Calls selected remaining, then selected size. If manager is metadata-download, sort=-1 and text blank after these calls. Otherwise selected size is numeric value and primary sort.
SizeItem.file: Uses full file length and wrap64(length-downloaded); obtains manager to apply the same metadata suppression.
SizeItem.secondary_sort_and_text: Composite size, remaining (or0 under simpleSort), second-line flag. Second line only maxLines>1 && remaining>0 && width>150. Custom size formatter precedes ordinary byte formatting. Tooltip can expose full-minus-selected bytes. These formatting/sorting requirements are separate from publishing a scalar selected-size DTO.

RemainingItem.manager: Checks metadata first→-1/blank; else selected remaining.
RemainingItem.file: Checks file metadata→-1/blank; else wrap64(length-downloaded), no numeric clamp.
RemainingItem.display: Any negative remaining is displayed blank, preserving raw negative sort value.

DoneItem.manager: Always stats-selected thousandths; no direct metadata guard.
DoneItem.file: If length==0 return1000; else jlongToInt(wrap64(downloaded*1000)/length). No clamp to[0,1000] and not the manager float formula.
DoneItem.format: DisplayFormatters.formatPercentFromThousands formats thousands/1000.0 through locale percentage formatter. Native one-decimal text may be a chosen UI adaptation, not exact original localized formatting.

ui_columns.metadata_precedence: Do not blanket-suppress Done because Size/Remaining suppress metadata. A pure snapshot can avoid executing original side-effectful Size pre-check calculations; that is value projection only, not full call/effect-order parity.

per_file_boundary.scope_owner: Codec owns per-file source acquisition/geometry/index/skip-policy architecture; these notes constrain its mathematics only.
source: DiskManagerImpl.storeFileDownloaded writes a filedownloaded map containing downloaded List<Long> in file order.

DiskManagerUtil.loadFileDownloaded returns when map/list absent, restores only min(files.length,list.size), and catches Throwable around the sequential element loop. A malformed middle element can leave a restored prefix with later skeleton counts at initial0. The list cast itself precedes that try.

FileSkeleton.downloaded initializes to0. Both skeleton and real file setDownloaded simply assign the supplied long; persisted values are not clamped there. Live setPieceDone later has separate clamps.
storeFilePriorities on non-real file sets recomputes K/B using file.getDownloaded, so original priority changes can alter cached DND aggregates and completeness.
native_known_requirements: Only publish known per-file progress after an owned exact identity/geometry/index mapping and explicit valid downloaded-count policy.
Do not turn missing/truncated/malformed saved list suffixes into verified zero downloaded bytes or report original partial recovery as complete source equality.
Keep file length, skipped state, padding, downloaded count and aggregate DND cache provenance distinct. Do not distribute aggregate C or received bytes across files.

knowledge_table.minimum: Established T and explicit K>=0, interpreted under an explicit arithmetic/validation policy.
knowledge_table.independent_of: C, B, F, live disk; zero/negative cached T alone does not establish original no-fixup T.

knowledge_table.minimum: Established full R (or nonnegative C,T with no original recalculation required), K>=0 and B or explicitly labelled original missing-B default0.
knowledge_table.unknown_when: Missing/negative C, missing/negative K, malformed types, unmatched cache hash or unavailable size unless independent coherent evidence resolves them.

knowledge_table.minimum: Known S: S==0→1000; S<0→0; S>0 also needs Q.
knowledge_table.independent_of: F and retained assumedComplete; percent does not prove those facts.

knowledge_table.minimum: Explicit valid F; if hasDnd then use bit2 without C; if noDnd need known R and exact R==0.
knowledge_table.unknown_when: F missing requires original facade path; invalid F requires separately declared native malformed-field policy.

knowledge_table.minimum: Preference plus authoritative adopted owner state or explicitly labelled saved controller/assumed-completion projection.
knowledge_table.unknown_when: Saved candidate alone cannot reproduce arbitrary retained assumedComplete lifecycle; preference itself unavailable/malformed is not automatically false unless default application is explicit.

knowledge_table.minimum: Owned geometry and valid per-index saved downloaded count, plus metadata fact and exact byte/float distinctions.
knowledge_table.unknown_when: Only aggregate C/K/B or a partial recovered list is available.

native_policy_choices_to_document: Separate optional full geometry/completed bytes, selected size/remaining/thousandths, metadata state, saved controller DND facts and completion classification; never overwrite full bytes/C with selected bytes.

For an accepted normal tuple, useful checks are 0<=C<=T, 0<=K<=T, 0<=B<=K and 0<=C-B<=T-K. These are conservative native publication conditions, not range checks present in the original getters. Preserve raw data/diagnostics when rejecting a tuple.
Absence of skipbdl can follow original default0 with explicit default provenance; stricter unknown publication is another policy and must be named.

Same-generation retained immutable cache/DTO ownership is needed when details/telemetry/snapshots update. A new full-byte telemetry value cannot silently retain stale selectedDone/remaining computed from older C.
Do not require N per-torrent opens for a startup cache projection: readLibrarySource already retains raw cacheDocument once. Codec owns concrete IO/reuse/lower-cap/error decisions.
Do not change the existing full-byte Progress/pane behavior while calling it exact original DND parity; route through the new declared data semantics and meaningful tests.

recommended_bounded_verification.credit: Native/source-reading-derived unit expectations only until actual independently fenced original runtime observations are obtained; an extracted/copied formula is not that observation.
cases: K absent/-1/other-negative, B absent vs0 vs malformed, F absent vs0/1/2/3 plus negative/highbits; parameters wrong type.
No DND, some DND, all skipped (S0), selected zero-length files, completed==length vs overlength.
Independent selected-size availability with C missing; S0 Done short-circuit without C/Q; unknown positive-S Done without Q.
C/T/K/B inconsistent boundaries, Q negative clamp, Q>S, no upperpercent clamp, wrap64 subtractions/multiplication and no C++ signed-overflow UB.
Float32 precision just below completion (Q>0 but rounded raw1000→999), binary32 conversion versus double; compare separate integer per-file formula.
F==0/2 ignores cachedComplete if hasDnd=false; F==1/3 without READY; includeDnd defaultfalse/true and unknown retained assumedComplete separately.
Metadata bit present/absent/malformed; Size/Remaining blank but no blanket Done suppression.
Per-file list absent/truncated/extra/bad middle type/out-of-range counts; explicit no false suffixzero or aggregate redistribution.
Snapshot/telemetry/details revision transitions clear/recompute dependent selected metrics and preserve target identity.
No writes, recovery constructor, per-row IO scan, file-size probe or original Java profile access.

findings.finding: Use ordered Java-long and float32 manager math, including S0→1000 and raw1000/Q>0→999, and distinguish per-file integer math.
Keep saved controller flags, selected percent and retained assumedComplete distinct; dndflags absence is not noDND.
Saved cache only cannot imply live verification, successful original recovery, nonpositive-size fixup outcome or assumed-state lifecycle equality.
Original malformed-type exceptions/defaults and unchecked inconsistent Long inputs must remain distinguishable from native conservative unknown/diagnostic policy.

unresolved_for_implementation: Decide and document publication of absent-B default0 versus stricter unknown with explicit provenance.
Select exact native normal-tuple limits and malformed/inconsistent-field diagnostics without silently changing original raw values.
Specify saved pane-candidate fallback when original retained assumed state or DND preference is unknown; do not invent a known original completion verdict.
Actual original-runtime arithmetic/completion observations, if desired, require a separately reviewed immutable inert seam and independent evidence; none exist in this review.
